name: Ghostcore
summary: The aesthetic of ghostcore is described as "dark, haunted, and ethereal -like landscapes, cemeteries, the spiritual world and connecting to it, haunted artifacts, dark and mysterious history, legends and ghost stories, and more" according to a private Ghostcore Facebook page.
